matthew-1-1-17.title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 1:1-17
matthew-1-1-17.caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 1:1-17</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
matthew-1-1-17.usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="1:1" /> The scroll of the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενεσις">birth-beginning  </char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous Messiah</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        son of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Dauid</char>, son of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Abra’am</char>: 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="2" /> Abra’am<verse number="1" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενναω">birthed  </char> Isaak, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Isaak<verse number="2" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iakob, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iakob<verse number="3" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Iouda and his brothers</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="3" /> and Iouda<verse number="4" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Phares and Zara <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from Tamar</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Phares<verse number="5" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Esrom, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Esrom<verse number="6" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Aram, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> and Aram<verse number="7" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Aminadab, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Aminadab<verse number="8" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Nasson, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Nasson<verse number="9" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Salmon, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> and Salmon<verse number="10" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Boes <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from Rakhab</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Boes<verse number="11" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iobed <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from Ruth</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iobed<verse number="12" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iessai, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="6" /> and Iessai<verse number="13" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Dauid</char> <verse number="14," /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">the king,</char>
      </group>
      <group>
        and Dauid<verse number="14" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Solomon <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from the one of Ouriah</char>, 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="7" /> and Solomon<verse number="15" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Roboam, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Roboam<verse number="16" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Abia, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Abia<verse number="17" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Asaph, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="8" /> and Asaph<verse number="18" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iosaphat, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iosaphat<verse number="19" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ioram, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Ioram<verse number="20" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ozia, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="9" /> and Ozia<verse number="21" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iotham, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Iotham<verse number="22" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Akhaz, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Akhaz<verse number="23" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ezekia, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="10" /> and Ezekia<verse number="24" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Manasse, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Manasse<verse number="25" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Amos, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Amos<verse number="26" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iosiah, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="11" /> and Iosia<verse number="27" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">Iekhonia</char> <verse number="28" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">and his brothers</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        until <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="12" /> After <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        Iekhonia<verse number="28" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Salathiel, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Salathiel<verse number="29" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Zorobabel, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="13" /> and Zorobabel<verse number="30" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Abioud, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Abioud<verse number="31" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Eliakim, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Eliakim<verse number="32" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Azor, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="14" /> and Azor<verse number="33" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Sadok, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Sadok<verse number="34" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Akhim, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Akhim<verse number="35" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Elioud, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="15" /> and Elioud<verse number="36" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Eleazar, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Eleazar<verse number="37" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Matthan, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and Matthan<verse number="38" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Iakob, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="16" /> and Iakob<verse number="39" /> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> Ioseph<verse number="40," /> the husband of <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Maria</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">from</char> whom was <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous</char> <verse number="41," /> 
      </group>
      <group>
        who is called “Messiah.” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="17" /> All the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενεα">birth-generations  </char> from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Abra’am</char> until <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Dauid</char>: fourteen <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth-generations</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and from Dauid until <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char>: fourteen <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth-generations</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and from <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">the exile of Babylon</char> until <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">the Messiah</char>: fourteen <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth-generations</char>. 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>

matthew-1-18-25.title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 1:18-25
matthew-1-18-25.caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 1:18-25</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
matthew-1-18-25.usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="18" /> Now, the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange" word-lang="greek" word-original="γενεσις">birth-beginning  </char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous Messiah</char> was this way: 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          His mother, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Maria</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          having been <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">engaged</char> to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">before they had come together</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          she was found to <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">have in the womb by the Holy Spirit</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="19" /> and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph her husband</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          being a righteous one, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b'">
          and not desiring to make her a public spectacle, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">he</char> wanted to send <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">her</char> away privately. 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="20" /> And while he was thinking about these things, 
        </group>
        <group>
          look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">a messenger of the Lord</char> appeared to him in <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">a dream</char>, saying, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          “<char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph</char>, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">of Dauid</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          do not be afraid <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">to take</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Maria</char> as your <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">wife</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          because what has been <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">inside her</char>
        </group>
        <group indent="2">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">is from the Holy Spirit</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
          <verse number="21" /> and she will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth</char> a <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">you will call his name</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous</char>,
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          because he will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">save</char> his people from their moral-failings.” 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        <verse number="22" /> And all of this happened 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        so that what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet would be filled-full, saying, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
        <verse number="23" /> “Look, <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">the virgin</char> will <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="turquoise">have in the womb</char> and will <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birth</char> a <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="2">
        and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="black">they will call his name</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">Emmanuel</char>,
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a'">
        which is translated ‘<char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="violet">With Us Is God</char>.’” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group>
        <verse number="24" /> And, after <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">Ioseph</char> got up from <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">sleep</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        he did as <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">the messenger of the Lord</char> commanded him, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">he took his</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">wife</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        <verse number="25" /> and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">he did not know her</char> until she <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">birthed</char> a <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="purple">son</char>, 
      </group>
      <group>
        and he called his name <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iesous</char>.
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>

matthew-2-1-12.title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 2:1-12
matthew-2-1-12.caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 2:1-12</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
matthew-2-1-12.usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="1" /> Now, when <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">Iesous</char> had <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">been</char> born in <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Ioudaia</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          in the days of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">Herodes the king</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          look, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">magi</char> from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the eastern regions</char> arrived in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Hierosoluma</char>, <verse number="2" /> saying, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          “Where is the one <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">born</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">king</char> of the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Ioudeans</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          because we saw <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">his star in the east</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">we have come to bow down to him</char>.” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="3" /> And when <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">King Herodes</char> heard, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he was troubled, and all of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Hierosoluma</char> with him, 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> and having gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people, 
      </group>
      <group>
        he inquired from them <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">where</char> the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">messiah</char> is to be <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">born</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> And they said to him 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “In <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Ioudaia</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        because that’s how it was written through the prophets, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <verse number="6" /> ‘And you, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char> of the land of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iouda</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        you are by no means least among the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">rulers</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iouda</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        because from you will come <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">a ruler</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        who will shepherd my people, Israel.’” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="7" /> Then <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">Herodes</char>, having privately called <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">the magi</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he learned precisely from them the time of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the shining star</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <verse number="8" /> and having sent them to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char>, he said, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “As you go make a careful examination about <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the child</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and when you find him, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise">report to me</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          so that <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">I too may come and bow down to him</char>.” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="9" /> And having listened to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">the king</char> they went, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the star</char> which they saw <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">in the east</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          it went ahead of them until going on it stood over the place where <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the child</char> was, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <verse number="10" /> and seeing <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the star</char>, they rejoiced with very great joy, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="11" /> and coming into <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">the house</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          they saw <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the child</char> with Maria his mother, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          and falling down 
        </group>
        <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">they bowed down to him</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
          and opening up their treasures, 
        </group>
        <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d'">
          they brought to him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="12" /> and having been warned in a dream <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise">not to return</char> to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">Herodes</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          they departed by another road unto their own country. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>

matthew-2-13-23.title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 2:13-23
matthew-2-13-23.caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 2:13-23</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
matthew-2-13-23.usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="13" /> And after they departed, 
        </group>
        <group>
          look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="blue">a messenger of the Lord</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">shone-in-appearance</char> to Ioseph <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">in a dream</char>, saying, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “<char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">Getting up, take</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the child</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and his mother</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and flee <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">to Egypt</char> and be there until whenever I speak to you! 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          For <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Herodes</char> is about <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">to seek</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the child</char>, to destroy him.” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="14" /> And <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">getting up, he took</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="tan">the child</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="green">and his mother</char> by night, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="green">he departed</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="orange">to Egypt</char>, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="3" sidebar-value="C" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="15" /> and he was there until <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="red">the death-end of</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="red">Herodes</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">in order to</char> <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="cyan">fill-full</char> <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="cyan">what was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying</char>,
